name: Tumerok Outpost (1.9N, 56.7W)
title: 1.9N, 56.7W - Tumerok Outpost
summary: A small walled Tumerok outpost (locked door, four loot chests inside per acpedia) on a rocky ledge in the Dires south-east of Fort Tethana. The kit shows a compact block of flat-roofed black stone halls and doorways (0x01001130, 0x01001124, 0x0100115E), about 75 x 30 m at z 128, crowned with wooden stake palisades. The barren rock falls away 40 m to the north and west, and a rock-cave hut (granite golems) sits on the slope 110 m south-west.

landmarks.name: Outpost halls
landmarks.note: Flat-roofed black stone halls with stake palisades on the roofs (props 0x01001126/27/28 at z 133-135).

shots.standingOrder: Hover 18 m above the rocky slope 60 m south-south-west of the outpost looking almost straight down, then tilt up over its spiked roofs to the falling ground and the Dires beyond; drift only 6 m.
shots.notes: The lens hovers 18-20 m above the rocky slope 60 m south-south-west of the walled outpost (flat-roofed black stone halls crowned with wooden stake palisades, z 128). It looks almost straight down and tilts from -80 deg to -12 deg while drifting 6 m, so the stake-lined roofs slide up through the frame and the ground falls away to the north into the Dires. The early-afternoon sun is behind the left shoulder. The subject enters the frame during the tilt (take 59%), and the edit window starts once it is in frame (96%).
